scope: Automatic preview preparation and adaptive admission budget, recovered session review and final macOS delivery. Functional qualification and exploratory comparison; no general performance or release-gate qualification.

behavior.growth: Atomic reservation of live credits plus new job, with max(10%, 256 MB) headroom; usable physical capacity leaves max(20%, 2 GB) to the system.
behavior.preparation: No user prefetch selector; extends the former Extended neighborhood according to bytes and idle time, with two admissions at a time and bounded recipe lookups. Recent viewing previews outrank speculative ones.
behavior.limits: Manual RAM/GPU/disk sublimits, read-only originals, pipe allowlist and XPC isolation retained; no lower-quality success is substituted for an impossible request.
behavior.migration: Schema 3, exact original JSON backup, migration of all three prefetch values without resetting unrelated preferences.
behavior.battery: Off by default or when absent; explicit existing settings preserved.
behavior.active_display: Actual SDR 8/10/16-float format, with distinct pending-change and fallback messages in Italian/English.

review_findings.problem: Historical working headroom could exceed the current budget after pressure, permanently blocking subsequent folder and neighbor preparation.
review_findings.correction: Track only admitted work and cap speculative headroom at 75% of the current budget. Actual jobs retain atomic admission, growth and reclamation.
review_findings.scope: Foreground/background scheduling after an impossible request or simulated return from an expanded budget to the base; no physical pressure injection.

visual_inspection.scope: Inspected final native Italian/English preferences, compact and 200% layouts, and actual installed app at 100% UI: automatic preparation replaces selector; SDR 8-bit is readable; battery reduction unchecked; memory base 8000.63 MB, budget 8.00 GB, used/reserved 827.2 MB. Controls, scrolling and footer fit. App left on completed 12-image test corpus grid.

native_viewer.scope: Fit viewing after preparation, retaining only independent viewing previews; native GPU readback versus CPU reference. Two sources, not a broad camera corpus.

normal_cache.scope: Production folder scheduler, all RAW engines, 1440x900 points / Retina 2x, 2 GiB; private source copies and isolated catalogues. Cold preparation then RAM eviction and fitted/native-quality viewers reloaded from disk. Optional saved recipe on the second photo uses a different engine and native WB. No GPU/display, colour or physical-memory qualification.

disabled.scope: Isolated native folder loading and cache clear during foreground/background preparation, disk deletion and fresh decoding. Fitted viewer and thumbnail preparation; not native 1:1, GPU readiness or guaranteed disk retention beyond configured quotas.

limited.scope: Isolated native folder loading and cache clear during foreground/background preparation, disk deletion and fresh decoding. Fitted viewer and thumbnail preparation; not native 1:1, GPU readiness or guaranteed disk retention beyond configured quotas.

settings.scope: Four preferences tabs in English/Italian, minimum window and 200% UI zoom on synthetic corpus. Not full accessibility/display qualification.

xpc.production_rejection: TrueRenderer: Il servizio non è una build di fault injection

performance.comparison: Old Extended versus automatic at identical 8 GB budget base (rounded up to MiB), 2048 MiB reusable RAM and 512 MiB GPU cache; distinct generated images, Apple bitmap decode and GPU viewer.
performance.scope: Application cache cold/reopened; OS disk cache is not purged. End-to-end software readback and process RSS/footprint sampling, not physical display or population p95/p99. Steps within a run are dependent. No physical memory-pressure injection.

performance_interpretation: The experiment records resident previews, redraw latency, completed decode jobs and sampled process memory. Extra speculation can perform more decodes. Run medians and variation are reported without a p95/p99 or statistically qualified speedup claim; steps within a process are dependent.

baseline_instrumentation.scope: Same replay instrumentation, plus failed-surface capture after timing endpoint; original production behavior unchanged.

negative_evidence.case: Earlier baseline pilot, 1600 ms dwell and 1536 MiB reusable cache
negative_evidence.scope: Preserved failed surface comparison; subsequent attempts did not reproduce it. Not counted as a passing performance run and no production fix claimed.

negative_evidence.followup: Passed in isolation and 30 diagnostic repetitions. Test now waits for a valid PID rather than mere file existence and retains the process-liveness assertion with error detail. Complete final suite passed. The initial failure was not conclusively attributed to this readiness race.

limitations: Single macOS Apple M4 machine; Windows and other camera families not requalified.

Admission growth/concurrency and pressure recovery tested through live-credit accounting and simulated notifications; not proof of safe arbitrary physical RAM exhaustion, all driver allocations or a kernel-enforced working set.
Performance comparison uses 30 distinct generated 4096x3000 PNGs with Apple bitmap decode and GPU presentation; the four-engine RAW matrix is a separate functional test.

Two repetitions per configuration; application cache controlled, OS disk cache not purged. RSS/footprint sums may double-count shared pages and miss peaks between samples. System swap belongs to the whole machine.
Replay measures selection and returns in Fit, not physical monitor refresh, a large-grid throughput campaign, native RAW zoom for every engine or p95/p99.
Not every photo remains resident: optional cache can be evicted and requested content may need disk reads, uploads, rendering or new decoding.
Ad hoc signature and XPC tests do not close distribution, color, accessibility, memory or R0-R4/SF gates.
